articles.title: 【葉底藏花】GenAI（仍遠遠）不是新進化物種   ——唯物史觀、達爾文想像與生物類比的謬誤  – 鄒崇銘
articles.summary: 呢篇文話大家成日誤解咗達爾文講嘅「物競天擇」，仲用錯咗嘅諗法去睇GenAI。

levels.text: 呢篇文講馬克思寫嘅《資本論》，同達爾文嘅進化論好似，但好多人誤解咗「物競天擇，適者生存」呢句嘢。其實達爾文冇話邊個最叻先可以生存，只係話邊個啱環境先叫做適應到。而家啲人用呢種諗法去講GenAI，都係搞錯咗。
levels.text_en: This article talks about how Marx's Capital is similar to Darwin's theory of evolution, but many people misunderstand the phrase 'natural selection, survival of the fittest.' Actually, Darwin never said the smartest one survives — he only meant whoever fits the environment is considered 'adapted.' Nowadays people use this kind of thinking to talk about GenAI, and that's also a mistake.

levels.text: 呢篇文由鄒崇銘寫，講馬克思嘅《資本論》同達爾文嘅《物種起源》雖然係唔同範疇嘅書，但都反映住啟蒙運動嗰種對進步嘅想像。好多人以為「物競天擇，適者生存」係達爾文講嘅，其實係嚴復譯赫胥黎嘅《天演論》先出現，「適者生存」呢句仲係史賓塞創造。史賓塞式嘅「社會達爾文主義」帶住種族主義色彩，早就被人批評。達爾文原意嘅「適者」唔係話最強最叻，而係話喺特定環境入面啱唔啱適應，同氣候、資源、合作都有關。文章話而家啲人成日將GenAI比喻做進化過程嘅新物種，其實都係受咗呢種誤解嘅影響。
levels.text_en: This article, written by Chau Sung-ming, discusses how Marx's Capital and Darwin's Origin of Species, though belonging to different fields, both reflect the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress.' Many people think 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' was said by Darwin, but actually it first appeared when Yan Fu translated Huxley's Tianyanlun (Evolution and Ethics), and the phrase 'survival of the fittest' was actually coined by Spencer. Spencer-style 'Social Darwinism' carries racist overtones and has long been criticized. Darwin's original meaning of 'the fittest' was not about being the strongest or smartest, but about whether something is suited to a specific environment, which relates to climate, resources, and cooperation. The article says that people nowadays constantly use the metaphor of GenAI as a new species in an evolutionary process, which is actually influenced by this same misunderstanding.

levels.text: 文章指出，馬克思喺1867年出版嘅《資本論》，同早八年面世、達爾文嘅《物種源始》（1859），雖然屬於完全不同嘅學術範疇，卻同樣承載住啟蒙運動對「進步」嘅想像，構成現代文明嘅深層文化底蘊。作者特別提到，「物競天擇，適者生存」呢句廣為人知嘅名言，其實並非出自達爾文本人，而係十九世紀末嚴復翻譯赫胥黎《天演論》時所用，「適者生存」呢詞更加係英國哲學家史賓塞喺1864年提出。嚴復翻譯時融入咗史賓塞嘅「社會達爾文主義」思想，令呢種帶種族主義同帝國主義色彩嘅理論廣泛流傳，但早已受到學術界批評。作者強調，達爾文所講嘅「fittest」並非指最強或最先進，而係指物種喺特定環境入面嘅相對適應，涉及氣候、地景、水源、繁殖同共生等因素。進化並唔係一場淘汰賽，而係不斷分化同適應嘅過程。文章暗示，將呢種誤解類比套用喺GenAI身上，都係一種謬誤。
levels.text_en: The article points out that Marx's Capital, published in 1867, and Darwin's On the Origin of Species (1859), which appeared eight years earlier, though belonging to completely different academic fields, both carry the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress,' forming a deep cultural foundation of modern civilization. The author specifically notes that the well-known saying 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' did not actually come from Darwin himself, but was used by Yan Fu in his translation of Huxley's Tianyanlun in the late 19th century, and the term 'survival of the fittest' was actually proposed by the British philosopher Spencer in 1864. When translating, Yan Fu incorporated Spencer's 'Social Darwinism' ideas, causing this theory — which carries racist and imperialist overtones — to spread widely, though it has long been criticized by academia. The author emphasizes that what Darwin meant by 'fittest' was not the strongest or most advanced, but rather a species' relative adaptation within a specific environment, involving factors such as climate, terrain, water sources, reproduction, and symbiosis. Evolution is not an elimination contest, but a continuous process of differentiation and adaptation. The article implies that applying this same misunderstanding as an analogy to GenAI is likewise a fallacy.

levels.text: 作者指出，馬克思的《資本論》與達爾文的進化論雖屬不同學科，卻同樣體現了啟蒙運動對「進步」的想像。許多人以為「物競天擇，適者生存」出自達爾文，其實這句話源於嚴復翻譯赫胥黎的《天演論》，而「適者生存」一詞則是英國哲學家史賓塞提出的。史賓塞式的「社會達爾文主義」帶有種族主義色彩，早被學術界批評。作者強調，達爾文所說的「適者」並非指最強或最先進，而是指物種在特定環境中的適應程度，這涉及氣候、資源、繁殖與共生等多種因素。進化不是一場由強者勝出的淘汰賽，而是不斷分化與適應的過程。文章最後指出，將這種誤解套用於理解GenAI，同樣是一種謬誤。
levels.text_en: The author points out that although Marx's Capital and Darwin's theory of evolution belong to different disciplines, they both embody the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress.' Many people believe that 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' comes from Darwin, but in fact this phrase originates from Yan Fu's translation of Huxley's Tianyanlun, while the term 'survival of the fittest' was proposed by the British philosopher Spencer. Spencer-style 'Social Darwinism' carries racist overtones and has long been criticized by academia. The author emphasizes that what Darwin meant by 'the fittest' was not the strongest or most advanced, but rather the degree of a species' adaptation within a specific environment, involving factors such as climate, resources, reproduction, and symbiosis. Evolution is not an elimination contest won by the strong, but a continuous process of differentiation and adaptation. The article concludes by pointing out that applying this same misunderstanding to understanding GenAI is likewise a fallacy.

levels.text: 近160年前，馬克思出版了《資本論》（1867），奠下了一個多世紀以來，人們對某種進步或高階社會的理想、或幻想。 這裡倒不是要搶閘對《資本論》作回顧，而是更具針對性地力圖論證：《資本論》以至馬克思的 「唯物史觀」（historical materialism），儘管和僅僅早八年面世、 達爾文 的《物種源始》 （1859），屬於完全不同學術範疇的著作；但卻同樣承載著濃厚的 啟蒙運動的精神想像，共同構成 現代文明的深層文化底蘊，兩者著實存在著驚人的相似之處。 尤其重要的是：這些涉及高階社會、生命、物種和進化的類比，對當下關於「生成式人工智能」 （GenAI）的普遍誤解，實在造成了舉足輕重的重大影響。 對「物競天擇，適者生存」的長期誤解 所謂「物競天擇，適者生存」，相信大家自小都已耳熟能詳。很多人都知道，這句中文名言，乃來 自十九世紀末嚴復所翻譯、達爾文追隨者赫胥黎撰寫的《天演論》 (1893)，而並非直接來自達爾文 的《物種起源》。尤其「適者生存」（survival of the fittest）一語，更不是達爾文原創，而是英國 哲學家史賓塞在1864年提出。 嚴復在翻譯赫胥黎時，曾大量融入史賓塞的「社會達爾文主義」（Social Darwinism）思想，遂令 「物競天擇，適者生存」廣為流傳，成為華文世界理解進化論最深入民心的八個字。 很多人卻未必知道，「適者生存」即使後來獲達爾文本人接納，卻極易對進化論的原來含意造成扭 曲。時至今日，大概很少人會全盤否定達爾文的進化論；但史賓塞式的社會達爾文主義，尤其是它 濃烈種族主義、帝國主義和歷史命定論的意味，早已受到學術界的廣泛批判。大概只有少數極右翼 法西斯主義者，仍對史賓塞思想一直加以堅持。 若我們並不是談史賓塞，而是回到達爾文本身：所謂的fittest，便不等於最強壯、最聰明、最先進， 更絕不代表在競爭中擊敗其他物種的勝利者。它首先指向的，是不同物種在特定環境中的相對成功 適應。適應過程固然會受到物種之間競爭的影響，卻也取決於氣候、地景、水源、養分、繁殖、合 作、共生，以至無數其他的生態互動關係。 換句話說，進化並不是一場所有生命參與競逐、最終由最強者勝出的淘汰賽；更不是一條從「低 等」生命，逐步攀升至「高等」生命的單向階梯。 其實只需放眼我們身處的地球便知道。 自從五億多年前的寒武紀大爆發，到今天極為繁複的生境和生物多樣性，進化並非一物種接另一物 種登上冠軍寶座，而是不斷分化、繁衍和適應的混雜過程。各種生命在迥異的環境中生生不息、百 花齊放——假如進化真的只有最強者勝出，那麼地球上絕大部分的生命，豈不早就應被淘汰殆盡？ 試問又怎會出現今天這個由細菌、真菌、植物、昆蟲、魚類、鳥類、哺乳類，以至無數微生物相依 相偎、共存共榮的繁盛生命世界？ 從「社會達爾文主義」到「唯物史觀」 馬克思在撰寫《資本論》期間，顯然已相當
levels.text_en:
Nearly 160 years ago, Marx published Capital (1867), laying the groundwork for over a century of people's ideals — or illusions — about some kind of progress or higher-order society. This piece is not meant to be a retrospective review of Capital, but aims more specifically to argue: that Capital, and indeed Marx's 'historical materialism,' although belonging to a completely different academic field from Darwin's On the Origin of Species (published a mere eight years earlier, in 1859), nevertheless carries the same rich imaginative spirit of the Enlightenment. Together the two works form the deep cultural foundation of modern civilization, and indeed there are striking similarities between them. Most importantly: these analogies involving higher society, life, species, and evolution have had a decisive and major influence on today's widespread misunderstanding of 'Generative AI' (GenAI). 

On the long-standing misunderstanding of 'natural selection, survival of the fittest': Everyone has likely been familiar with this saying since childhood. Many people know that this famous Chinese phrase actually comes from Tianyanlun (Evolution and Ethics, 1893), translated in the late 19th century by Yan Fu from the work of Huxley, a follower of Darwin — not directly from Darwin's own Origin of Species. In particular, the phrase 'survival of the fittest' was not coined by Darwin at all, but was proposed by the British philosopher Herbert Spencer in 1864. When Yan Fu translated Huxley's work, he incorporated a large amount of Spencer's 'Social Darwinism' thinking, causing 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' to spread widely and become the eight-character phrase through which the Chinese-speaking world most deeply understood evolution. 

However, many people may not know that 'survival of the fittest,' even though it was later accepted by Darwin himself, can very easily distort the original meaning of evolutionary theory. Today, few people would completely deny Darwin's theory of evolution; but Spencer-style Social Darwinism — especially its strong overtones of racism, imperialism, and historical determinism — has long been widely criticized by academia. Probably only a small number of far-right fascists still cling to Spencer's ideas. 

If we set Spencer aside and return to Darwin himself: the so-called 'fittest' does not mean the strongest, the smartest, or the most advanced, and certainly does not mean the victor who defeats other species in competition. What it primarily refers to is the relative successful adaptation of different species within a specific environment. While the adaptation process is indeed influenced by competition between species, it also depends on climate, terrain, water sources, nutrients, reproduction, cooperation, symbiosis, and countless other ecological interactions. 

In other words, evolution is not an elimination contest in which all living things compete and the strongest ultimately wins; nor is it a one-way ladder climbing step by step from 'lower' life forms to 'higher' ones. 

In fact, one only needs to look at the planet we live on to see this. From the Cambrian explosion over 500 million years ago to today's extremely complex habitats and biodiversity, evolution is not a matter of one species after another ascending to a championship throne, but rather a mixed, continuous process of differentiation, reproduction, and adaptation. Various life forms thrive and flourish in vastly different environments — if evolution really only meant the strongest winning, wouldn't the vast majority of life on Earth have long since been eliminated? How else could today's flourishing world of life exist, where bacteria, fungi, plants, insects, fish, birds, mammals, and countless microorganisms depend on each other and coexist in mutual prosperity?

articles.summary_en: This is an opinion piece by Chau Sung-ming (鄒崇銘) arguing that people misunderstand Darwin's phrase 'survival of the fittest' and are wrongly applying that misunderstanding as an analogy when talking about GenAI (generative AI) as if it were a new evolving species; the article also connects this to Marx's Capital and 19th-century Chinese translations of evolutionary theory.

articles.title: 【專訪劉香成．上】紀實攝影人眼中的世界：蘇聯解體與中國崛起
articles.summary: 呢篇文講攝影師劉香成點樣影相記錄新中國同蘇聯嘅歷史大事。

levels.text: 劉香成係一個影相記者，佢喺美國雜誌做嘢，之後返去中國影相。佢細個喺福州大，屋企唔係紅五類，冇戴紅領巾。毛澤東死咗之後，佢返中國影好多日常生活嘅相。佢出咗本書叫《苦海餘生》，講中國人辛苦嘅生活。書入面有好多相，有孩子鬥四人幫，又有人睇大字報。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a photojournalist who worked at an American magazine and then went back to China to take photos. As a child he grew up in Fuzhou; his family was not from the 'red five categories' and he didn't wear a red scarf. After Mao Zedong died, he went back to China and photographed a lot of everyday life. He published a book called 'Bitter Sea Survivors' about the hard lives of Chinese people. The book had many photos, including children denouncing the Gang of Four and people reading big-character posters.

levels.text: 劉香成係一個紀實攝影記者，1978年派駐中國，做《時代》雜誌記者，係首八個派駐北京嘅美國記者之一。佢細個喺福州長大，父親做過《大公報》編輯，母親係大地主後代，所以佢喺班度係唯一冇戴紅領巾嘅同學。長大後佢去美國讀國際關係，仲學埋攝影，之後做咗《時代》同美聯社嘅首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世之後，佢返返去中國，見證新時代開始。1983年，佢出咗本書，收錄1976到1982年嘅相片，有四人幫被鬥、西單民主牆、農民收割白菜等等，記錄中國普通人嘅日常生活。呢本書後尾改名叫做《A Life in a Sea of Red》。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photojournalist who was posted to China in 1978 as a reporter for Time magazine, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. He grew up in Fuzhou as a child; his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother came from a family of large landowners, so he was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations and also studied photography, later becoming chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong's death, he went back to China and witnessed the beginning of a new era. In 1983, he published a book collecting photos taken between 1976 and 1982, including the denunciation of the Gang of Four, the Xidan Democracy Wall, farmers harvesting cabbage, and more, recording the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. This book was later renamed 'A Life in a Sea of Red'.

levels.text: 劉香成係一位紀實攝影師，1978年以《時代》雜誌記者身份派駐中國，係首八位派駐北京嘅美國記者之一，翌年中美就正式建交。佢細個喺福州長大，父親曾任《大公報》編輯，母親係清官後代、大地主，因此佢被視為「黑五類」後代，係全班唯一冇戴紅領巾嘅學生。長大後佢赴美修讀國際關係，並因選修攝影師Gjon Mili嘅課程而成為佢嘅實習生，之後展開專業攝影生涯，先後擔任《時代》同美聯社嘅首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世之後，劉香成雖然趕唔切採訪葬禮，但剛好見證新時代嘅開始。1983年，佢將1976至1982年拍攝嘅照片輯錄成書，內容包括孩子批鬥四人幫、北京市民圍觀西單民主牆嘅大字報、農民收割白菜、青年喺毛澤東像前玩滑輪等等，呈現中國庶民嘅日常生活。呢本書2010年先至喺內地出版，因為原本嘅書名被視為政治唔正確。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photographer who was posted to China in 1978 as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing; the following year, China and the US formally established diplomatic relations. He grew up in Fuzhou; his father had once been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother was descended from an official family and large landowners, so he was regarded as belonging to the 'black five categories' and was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations, and because he took a photography course taught by photographer Gjon Mili, he became his intern, launching his professional photography career; he later served as chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong died, although Liu didn't make it back in time to cover the funeral, he happened to witness the start of a new era. In 1983, he compiled photos taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book, including children denouncing the Gang of Four, Beijing residents gathering to view big-character posters at the Xidan Democracy Wall, farmers harvesting cabbage, and young people roller-skating in front of a statue of Mao Zedong—capturing the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. The book was only published in mainland China in 2010, because its original title was considered politically incorrect.

levels.text: 劉香成是一位紀實攝影師。1978年，他以《時代》雜誌記者身份被派到中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。他小時候在福州長大，父親曾任《大公報》編輯，母親出身大地主家庭，因此他被視為「黑五類」後代，是全班唯一沒有戴紅領巾的學生。長大後他到美國讀國際關係，又跟隨攝影師Gjon Mili學習攝影，後來成為《時代》和美聯社的首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世後，他回到中國，正好見證一個新時代的開始。1983年，他把1976至1982年拍攝的照片編成一本書，記錄了批鬥四人幫、西單民主牆、農民收割白菜等場景，呈現普通中國人的日常生活。這本書直到2010年才在內地出版，因為原本的書名被認為政治不正確。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photographer. In 1978, he was posted to China as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. He grew up in Fuzhou as a child; his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother came from a family of large landowners, so he was regarded as being descended from the 'black five categories' and was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations, and also studied photography under photographer Gjon Mili, later becoming chief photographer for Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong's death, he returned to China and happened to witness the beginning of a new era. In 1983, he compiled photos he had taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book, documenting scenes such as the denunciation of the Gang of Four, the Xidan Democracy Wall, and farmers harvesting cabbage—capturing the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. The book wasn't published in mainland China until 2010, because its original title was considered politically incorrect.

levels.text: 一. 苦海過後的新中國 美國已故總統尼克遜（Richard Nixon）於1972年訪華後，美國媒體開始對中國產生較大的興趣。那時，美國三大報刊記者Fox Butterfield（《紐約時報》）、Richard Bernstein（《時代》雜誌）、Jay Mathews（《華盛頓郵報》）爭先出版一部關於中國的書，劉香成在1978年作為《時代》雜誌記者派駐中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。翌年，中美便正式建交了。 最終Fox Butterfield搶先出版了，書名為《苦海餘生》（China：Alive in the Bitter Sea，1982），書中照片都是劉香成的作品。「這本書在那個時代是比較深刻的報道，可以說是很有分量、關於新中國的報道。」劉香成的新書書名叫做 《A Life in a Sea of Red》 （中文暫譯作《紅海餘生》），正是呼應該部三十七年前的作品。 「苦海餘生是中國道家思想，形容人類要過這一生所面對的是苦海，社會狀況多多少少都是很苦的。在這麼苦的人生裏面，你怎樣找到平衡，找到自己生活的理念。所以，苦海餘生是形容中國人很深刻的生活體驗。」這種苦，也許年幼時的劉香成也嘗過一點：1951年出生於香港，十歲前在福州念書，父親是知識分子，曾任《大公報》編輯，母親則是清官後代、大地主，因此，劉香成作為「黑五類」後代，是班中幾十名同學之中，唯一沒帶上紅領巾的。 正因在內地度過童年，使劉香成對中國、對政治有了興趣，長大後就到美國念國際關係，因選修《Life》雜誌攝影師Gjon Mili的攝影課，輾轉做了他的實習生，展開了自己的專業生涯，先後擔任《時代》及美聯社的首席攝影記者。 毛澤東去世之後，也是劉香成回到中國的時機，雖然趕不及回去採訪毛澤東的葬禮，卻剛好見證一個新時代之始。「在大陸，我從第一天就知道這是人類一個很大的故事，如果這個故事那麼大，而我又做紀實攝影的，你不去為這故事投資時間、精力，那還有什麼可做？」 1983年，劉香成首度把攝於1976至1982年的照片輯錄成書：孩子高舉拳頭批鬥四人幫、七十年代末北京市民圍看「西單民主牆」大字報、北京農民收割大白菜、大連青年在毛澤東像前玩滑輪，年輕情侶在街上依偎，或是穿着列寧裝卻拿着「可口可樂」的青年。 記錄的都是那些年中國庶民的日常，畫面雖然沒他採訪八九民運、韓國民運、蘇聯阿富汗戰爭那麼動魄驚心，也沒政治巨人那麼具標誌性，但眾生相往往是最富詩意的時代見證。這書在1983年初次出版，但至2010年左右才於內地面世。「當時很有趣，大陸不敢稱此書為《毛之後的中國》，在大陸，什麼是political correctness（政治正確）很重要，你叫毛澤東之後的中國，很disrespectful（不尊重）。」 二. 從天安門跑到克里姆林宮 1989年在北京天安門廣場的報道是劉香成的「成名作」之一，獲得新聞界廣
levels.text_en:
I. New China After the Bitter Sea

After the late US President Richard Nixon visited China in 1972, American media began taking greater interest in China. At that time, journalists from three major American publications—Fox Butterfield (The New York Times), Richard Bernstein (Time), and Jay Mathews (The Washington Post)—raced to publish a book about China. Liu Heung Shing was posted to China in 1978 as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. The following year, China and the US formally established diplomatic relations.

In the end, Fox Butterfield published first, with the book titled 'China: Alive in the Bitter Sea' (1982), and the photographs in the book were all Liu Heung Shing's work. "This book was quite a profound piece of reporting for that era—you could say it was a weighty account of new China," Liu said. Liu's new book is titled 'A Life in a Sea of Red' (tentatively translated as such), echoing that earlier work from thirty-seven years before.

"'Bitter Sea Survivors' comes from Daoist thought in China, describing how the life humans must endure is a bitter sea—social conditions are, to some degree, always bitter. Within such a bitter life, how do you find balance, find your own philosophy of living? So 'Bitter Sea Survivors' describes a profound life experience of the Chinese people." This bitterness was perhaps something Liu Heung Shing himself tasted a little of as a child: born in Hong Kong in 1951, he studied in Fuzhou before the age of ten. His father was an intellectual who had served as an editor at Ta Kung Pao, while his mother was descended from an official family and was from a large landowning family. As a result, Liu, being descended from the 'black five categories,' was the only one among several dozen classmates who never wore a red scarf.

Precisely because he spent his childhood in mainland China, Liu developed an interest in China and in politics. Growing up, he went to the US to study international relations, and through taking a photography course by Life magazine photographer Gjon Mili, he ended up becoming his intern, launching his own professional career. He went on to serve as chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press.

After Mao Zedong's death, it was also the moment for Liu Heung Shing to return to China. Although he didn't make it back in time to cover Mao Zedong's funeral, he happened to witness the beginning of a new era. "On the mainland, from day one I knew this was a very big story of humanity. If the story is that big, and I'm doing documentary photography, if you don't invest your time and energy into this story, what else is there to do?"

In 1983, Liu Heung Shing for the first time compiled photographs taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book: children raising their fists to denounce the Gang of Four, Beijing residents in the late 1970s gathering to view big-character posters at the 'Xidan Democracy Wall,' Beijing farmers harvesting large cabbages, young people in Dalian roller-skating in front of a statue of Mao Zedong, young couples leaning against each other on the street, or young people wearing Lenin suits while holding Coca-Cola.

What was recorded was the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people during those years. Though the images were not as dramatic or heart-stopping as his coverage of the 1989 pro-democracy movement, the Korean democracy movement, or the Soviet-Afghan war, nor as iconic as photos of political giants, portraits of ordinary people are often the most poetic testimony to an era. This book was first published in 1983, but it wasn't until around 2010 that it appeared in mainland China. "It was quite interesting at the time—the mainland didn't dare call this book 'China After Mao.' In mainland China, what counts as political correctness matters a great deal; calling it 'China after Mao Zedong' would be seen as very disrespectful."

II. From Tiananmen to the Kremlin

The coverage of the 1989 events at Tiananmen Square in Beijing was one of Liu Heung Shing's 'breakthrough works,' earning him wide acclaim in the press industry—[text cuts off]

articles.summary: 一個十歲男仔喺跑馬地屋企暈咗，送院之後死咗，要等驗屍先知道死因。

levels.text: 一個十歲嘅男仔喺跑馬地間屋度暈低咗，冇晒反應。佢媽媽即刻報警，救護員好快嚟到，將佢送去醫院，不過到咗醫院之後，證實個男仔已經死咗。而家仲未知道佢點解死，要等驗屍之後先可以知道原因。
levels.text_en: A ten-year-old boy fainted at home in Happy Valley and had no response at all. His mother immediately called the police, and paramedics arrived quickly and took him to the hospital. However, after arriving at the hospital, the boy was confirmed dead. It is still not known why he died — this can only be known after an autopsy.

levels.text: 警方話，噚晚七點幾接到一個男仔阿媽報案，話個十歲仔喺黃泥涌道一百五十一號嘅住宅單位間房入面，懷疑暈低咗，仲昏迷咗添。救護員接報之後即刻趕到現場，將男仔送去律敦治醫院搶救。可惜到咗醫院之後，醫生證實男仔已經死咗。而家仲未知道男仔到底係點解死嘅，要等驗屍之後先可以確定真正嘅死因。
levels.text_en: Police said that last night around 7-something, they received a report from a boy's mother saying her ten-year-old son had fainted and fallen unconscious in a room of a residential unit at 151 Wong Nai Chung Road. Paramedics rushed to the scene after receiving the report and took the boy to Ruttonjee Hospital for emergency treatment. Unfortunately, after arriving at the hospital, doctors confirmed the boy had died. It is still unknown exactly how the boy died — this can only be confirmed after an autopsy.

levels.text: 警方話，事發喺跑馬地黃泥涌道一百五十一號一個住宅單位入面。當晚七時許，警方接獲男童母親報案，指佢個十歲嘅仔喺房間內懷疑暈低，並且昏迷不醒。救護員接報後迅速到場，將男童送往律敦治醫院搶救治理。可惜經過搶救，醫護人員最終證實男童已經不治死亡。事件發生之後，警方已經介入調查，不過目前仲未能夠確定男童嘅真正死因，需要等候驗屍報告出爐之後，先至可以進一步確定死因同埋事發經過。今次事件令人非常傷心，亦都引起街坊關注。
levels.text_en: Police said the incident happened at a residential unit at 151 Wong Nai Chung Road in Happy Valley. At around 7pm that night, police received a report from the boy's mother saying her ten-year-old son had fainted in his room and was unconscious. Paramedics rushed to the scene after receiving the report and took the boy to Ruttonjee Hospital for emergency treatment. Unfortunately, despite emergency treatment, medical staff ultimately confirmed the boy had died. After the incident, police have already stepped in to investigate, but at present the boy's true cause of death cannot yet be determined — this will require waiting for the autopsy report before the cause of death and the circumstances of the incident can be further confirmed. This incident is very saddening and has also drawn concern from local residents.

levels.text: 一名十歲男童在跑馬地的住宅內暈倒，送院後不治。警方指，晚上約七時接到男童母親報案，指男童在黃泥涌道一百五十一號一個單位的房間內暈倒昏迷。救護員到場後將他送往律敦治醫院搶救，最終證實死亡。死因有待驗屍後才能確定。
levels.text_en: A ten-year-old boy fainted inside a residence in Happy Valley and died after being taken to hospital. Police said that at around 7pm, they received a report from the boy's mother saying the boy had fainted and lost consciousness in a room of a unit at 151 Wong Nai Chung Road. Paramedics arrived at the scene and took him to Ruttonjee Hospital for emergency treatment, but he was ultimately confirmed dead. The cause of death awaits determination after an autopsy.

articles.title: 【人事世界】Clerks Award 新增 WFH 條款 – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 澳洲嘅工作機構決定喺文員嘅工作規則裡面加一條新規矩，等員工可以正式講想喺屋企做嘢，但老闘唔一定要應承。

levels.text: 澳洲嘅Fair Work Commission決定喺《Clerks Award》裡面加一條新規則，等做文員嗰啲人可以正式講想喺屋企做嘢。老闘唔一定要應承呢個請求，但如果之後老闘對嗰個人唔好，就要證明係因為生意，唔係因為佢提出咗呢件事。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission decided to add a new rule to the Clerks Award, allowing clerical workers to formally ask to work from home. The boss doesn't have to agree to this request, but if the boss later treats that person badly, they must prove it was for business reasons, not because the person raised this request.

levels.text: 澳洲嘅Fair Work Commission（FWC）喺2026年8月27日公布決定，話會喺《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》加多一條新clause 5A，等文員可以正式提出想喺屋企做嘢嘅request。不過，呢個唔等於員工有權一定要WFH，老闘仍然可以唔批准。如果員工提出request之後，好快就被人降職或者被dismiss，公司就要清楚證明係因為生意原因，唔係因為佢用咗呢個權利。因為呢個request係受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障嘅workplace right。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) announced a decision on 27 August 2026 that it will add a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, allowing clerical workers to formally make a request to work from home. However, this doesn't mean employees have an absolute right to WFH — bosses can still refuse. If an employee is demoted or dismissed soon after making the request, the company must clearly prove it was for business reasons, not because the employee exercised this right. This is because the request is a workplace right protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act.

levels.text: 根據澳洲Fair Work Commission（FWC）喺2026年8月27日公布嘅決定，佢哋建議喺《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》新增clause 5A，為受呢個award覆蓋嘅員工設立一個正式嘅work-from-home request機制。不過而家只係draft determination，最終條文仲要經過consultation，意見提交期限係2026年9月17日。FWC嘅Full Bench冇接受工會提出「員工request就應該自動獲批」呢個做法，佀話現有證據唔足夠支持一個強制性嘅監管介入，亦冇證據顯示僱主經常以任意或者歧視性理由拒絕request。換句話講，員工有正式request機制，但唔等於有『work from home嘅權利』。新clause 5A令僱主同員工可以透過協議調整部分僵化嘅award requirements，例如工作時間安排同埋meal and rest breaks，以配合已經存在嘅WFH安排。最重要嘅係，按clause 5A提出嘅request會受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障，即係僱主唔可以因為員工用咗呢個workplace right而採取adverse action，例如降職或者dismiss佢。
levels.text_en: According to a decision announced by Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) on 27 August 2026, they propose adding a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees covered by this award. However, this is currently only a draft determination — the final wording still needs to go through consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. The FWC's Full Bench did not accept the union's proposal that an employee's request should be automatically approved, stating that existing evidence is insufficient to support mandatory regulatory intervention, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse requests for arbitrary or discriminatory reasons. In other words, employees now have a formal request mechanism, but this does not equal a 'right to work from home'. The new clause 5A allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some of the award's rigid requirements — such as working hours arrangements and meal and rest breaks — to accommodate existing WFH arrangements. Most importantly, requests made under clause 5A will be protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, meaning employers cannot take adverse action against an employee — such as demotion or dismissal — because the employee exercised this workplace right.

levels.text: 澳洲公平工作委員會（Fair Work Commission，簡稱FWC）在2026年8月27日公布一項決定，建議在《文員私營行業獎項2020》（Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020）中新增條款5A，為員工設立正式的在家工作申請機制。目前這只是草案，最終內容還需經過諮詢，意見提交期限為2026年9月17日。委員會的全席審裁組並沒有接受工會提出的「申請即應獲批」建議，理由是現有證據不足以支持強制性規管，也沒有證據顯示僱主普遍以不合理理由拒絕申請。也就是說，員工只是有了正式申請的權利，並非自動獲得在家工作的權利。新條款讓僱主與員工可以透過協議調整部分僵化的規定，例如工作時間和用膳休息時間，以配合已有的在家工作安排。更重要的是，根據新條款提出的申請，將受《公平工作法》第340條保障，僱主不可以因員工行使這項權利而作出不利對待，例如降職或解僱。因此，僱主拒絕申請本身未必有問題，但之後如何處理，才是關鍵。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) announced a decision on 27 August 2026 proposing to add a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees. Currently this is only a draft, and the final content still needs to go through consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. The Commission's Full Bench did not accept the union's proposal that 'a request should be approved automatically', on the grounds that existing evidence is insufficient to support mandatory regulation, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse requests for unreasonable reasons. In other words, employees only gain the right to make a formal request, not an automatic right to work from home. The new clause allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some rigid provisions, such as working hours and meal/rest breaks, to fit existing work-from-home arrangements. More importantly, requests made under the new clause will be protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, and employers cannot take adverse action — such as demotion or dismissal — against an employee for exercising this right. Therefore, refusing a request itself may not be a problem, but how it is handled afterward is the key issue.

levels.text: 先旨聲明：呢次 Fair Work Commission（FWC）唔係修改《Fair Work Act》本身，而係決定修改《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》。FWC喺2026年8月27日公布決定，提出新增 clause 5A，為受 Clerks Award 覆蓋嘅員工建立一個正式嘅working-from-home request機制。不過，截至目前， FWC只係公布決定及draft determination， 最終條文仍然要經過drafting consultation， 相關意見提交期限係2026年9月17日。 FWC今次並冇接受工會提出嘅做法，即係員工提出WFH request之後，原則上應該獲得批准。Full Bench（審理小組）認為， 現有證據唔足以支持需要一個更加廣泛、強制性嘅監管介入， 亦冇證據顯示僱主普遍以任意、武斷或者歧視性理由拒絕WFH request。換句話講，員工有正式request mechanism，但唔等於有一個「right to work from home」。 呢個分別對僱主非常重要。 新clause 5A嘅核心，其實係令僱主同員工可以透過協議， 調整部分原本比較僵化嘅Award requirements，以配合已經存在嘅WFH arrangement。包括continuous ordinary hours、部分工作時間安排，以及meal and rest breaks等條款。換句話講，FWC唔係單純話「 可以喺屋企做嘢」， 而係承認傳統Award入面部分工作時間規則， 未必完全適合現代工作模式。 對員工而言，最大改變係：WFH request唔再只係公司policy或者manager discretion之下嘅informal conversation，而會成為Award framework入面一個正式機制。更加重要嘅係， FWC表示按照clause 5A提出嘅request會構成一項受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障嘅workplace right，而section 340禁止僱主因為員工擁有或者行使workplace right而採取adverse action。 呢一點可能先係今次改變對HR最值得留意嘅地方。 例如，一名員工正式提出WFH request，僱主原則上仍然可以唔同意。 但如果之後員工突然被降職、減少工作機會、 受到不合理performance management，甚至被dismiss， 而時間上又同request非常接近， 公司就需要非常清楚咁證明相關決定係基於真正嘅business reasons，而唔係因為員工行使咗一項workplace right。 因此，拒絕request本身未必係問題， 但點樣處理request，以及之後發生乜嘢
levels.text_en: First, to clarify: this time the Fair Work Commission (FWC) is not amending the Fair Work Act itself, but has decided to amend the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020. The FWC announced its decision on 27 August 2026, proposing to add a new clause 5A, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees covered by the Clerks Award. However, as of now, the FWC has only published the decision and a draft determination — the final wording still needs to go through drafting consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. This time, the FWC did not accept the union's proposal that once an employee makes a WFH request, it should in principle be approved. The Full Bench considered that existing evidence is insufficient to support the need for broader, mandatory regulatory intervention, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse WFH requests for arbitrary or discriminatory reasons. In other words, employees have a formal request mechanism, but this does not equal a 'right to work from home'. This distinction is very important for employers. The core of the new clause 5A is that it allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some of the award's originally rigid requirements to fit existing WFH arrangements — including continuous ordinary hours, some working hour arrangements, and meal and rest break provisions. In other words, the FWC is not simply saying 'you can work from home', but is acknowledging that some working hour rules in the traditional award may not fully suit modern work patterns. For employees, the biggest change is: a WFH request is no longer just an informal conversation subject to company policy or manager discretion, but becomes a formal mechanism within the award framework. More importantly, the FWC states that a request made under clause 5A constitutes a workplace right protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, and section 340 prohibits employers from taking adverse action against an employee because the employee has or exercises a workplace right. This point may be the most noteworthy aspect of this change for HR. For example, an employee formally makes a WFH request, and the employer can in principle still refuse. But if the employee is subsequently suddenly demoted, given fewer work opportunities, subjected to unreasonable performance management, or even dismissed — and the timing is very close to the request — the company will need to very clearly prove that the relevant decision was based on genuine business reasons, not because the employee exercised a workplace right. Therefore, refusing a request itself may not be the problem — but how the request is handled, and what happens afterward...

articles.title: 台東旅遊︳被忽略的台東　6處秘景比宮崎峻的吉卜力動畫世界更美
articles.summary: 呢篇文介紹台東六個好靚但好少人知嘅景點，個個都靚到好似動畫世界咁夢幻。

levels.text: 台東有六個好靚嘅地方，好少人知。成功鎮有間得意嘅卡片教堂，好似聖誕卡咁得意。東河鎮有個靚巴士站，用石頭同木整成，好似會見到龍貓咁。仲有間咖啡室，夜晚啲燈好靚，好似樹洞咁神秘。呢啲地方全部都好靚，好似動畫世界咁夢幻！
levels.text_en: Taitung has six very beautiful places that few people know about. Chenggong Town has a cute 'card church' that looks like a Christmas card. Donghe Town has a pretty bus stop made of stone and wood that looks like you might see Totoro there. There's also a coffee shop where the lights look beautiful at night, mysterious like a tree hollow. All these places are beautiful, like a dreamy animated world!

levels.text: 台東有六個好少人知嘅靚景點。第一個係成功鎮嘅卡片教堂，本身係間好舊嘅木教堂，後來因為打風壞咗，重建之後變得好得意，好似聖誕卡上面嘅教堂咁。第二個係東河鎮嘅知路橋公車站，用石頭同木整成，好多人話喺嗰度等車好似會見到龍貓。第三個係隆昌部落嘅「我在玩-玩冰箱」，賣早午餐，要預約先食到。第四個係加路蘭海岸，有好多藝術裝置，仲有間用漂流木整嘅小屋。第五個係Cheela小屋咖啡館，夜晚啲燈好靚，好似神秘嘅樹洞咁。呢啲地方全部都好靚，好似宮崎駿嘅動畫世界咁夢幻。
levels.text_en: Taitung has six beautiful scenic spots that few people know about. The first is the Card Church in Chenggong Town, originally a very old wooden church that was damaged by a typhoon and later rebuilt to become cute, like a church printed on a Christmas card. The second is the Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town, made of stone and wood — many people say waiting for the bus there feels like you might see Totoro. The third is 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge' in Longchang Tribal Village, which sells brunch but requires reservations to eat there. The fourth is Jialulan Coast, which has many art installations, including a small hut made of driftwood. The fifth is Cheela Cabin Café, where the lights at night look beautiful, like a mysterious tree hollow. All these places are beautiful, like a dreamy world from a Miyazaki animation.

levels.text: 台東位於海岸山脈同太平洋之間，有唔少鮮為人知嘅靚景。成功鎮宜灣部落嘅「卡片教堂」，原本係普通木教堂，1974年因颱風損毀，經建築師賴明德重建後，變成色彩繽紛、充滿歐洲鄉村風格嘅小教堂，吸引唔少導演取景。東河鎮嘅知路橋公車站，本來只係普通候車站，經人整理後用天然石牆同廢棄木料打造，背靠老檜木，被譽為全台最美候車亭。附近隆昌部落有間隱世小店「我在玩-玩冰箱」，供應限量早午餐，結合木工體驗同在地農產品。台東市嘅加路蘭海岸，原本係廢棄土置場，經整頓後變成結合藝術同生態嘅遊憩區，其中藝術家伊祐‧噶照用漂流木整嘅小屋最矚目。最後，Cheela小屋咖啡館入夜後燈火透過植物滲出，好似龍貓樹洞咁神秘夢幻，令人聯想起宮崎駿嘅吉卜力動畫世界。
levels.text_en: Taitung, located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, has many beautiful yet little-known scenic spots. The 'Card Church' in Yiwan Tribal Village, Chenggong Town, was originally an ordinary wooden church damaged by a typhoon in 1974. After being rebuilt by architect Lai Mingde, it became a colorful little church full of European countryside style, attracting many film directors to shoot there. The Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town was originally just an ordinary bus stop, but after being renovated using natural stone walls and discarded wood, and backed by an old cypress tree, it is now praised as the most beautiful bus shelter in Taiwan. Nearby in Longchang Tribal Village is a hidden little shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' offering limited brunch combined with woodworking experiences and local farm produce. Jialulan Coast in Taitung City was originally an abandoned dumping ground for soil, but after renovation it became a recreational area combining art and ecology, with the driftwood hut made by artist Iyo Kacaw being the most eye-catching feature. Finally, at Cheela Cabin Café, the lights that leak through plants at night look as mysterious and dreamy as Totoro's tree hollow, reminiscent of Miyazaki's Studio Ghibli animated world.

levels.text: 台東位於海岸山脈與太平洋之間，有六個鮮為人知的美麗景點。成功鎮的宜灣部落有一座「卡片教堂」，原本是普通木造教堂，1974年被颱風摧毀，後由建築師賴明德重建，變成色彩繽紛、風格獨特的小教堂。東河鎮的知路橋公車站，本來只是簡陋站牌，經人整理後用石頭與木料打造，被稱為全台最美候車亭。附近的隆昌部落有間隱世小店「我在玩-玩冰箱」，只供應限量早午餐，需預約才能享用。台東市的加路蘭海岸，原是廢棄土地，現已改建成結合藝術與生態的休憩區，設有多件藝術裝置，其中一間漂流木小屋最受歡迎。晚上的Cheela小屋咖啡館，燈光透過植物灑出，氣氛神秘夢幻。這些景點的美麗程度，堪比宮崎駿吉卜力動畫的世界。
levels.text_en: Located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, Taitung has six little-known and beautiful scenic spots. The 'Card Church' in Yiwan Tribal Village, Chenggong Town, was originally an ordinary wooden church, destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, then rebuilt by architect Lai Mingde into a colorful, uniquely styled small church. The Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town was originally just a simple sign, but after renovation using stone and wood, it became known as the most beautiful bus shelter in Taiwan. Nearby in Longchang Tribal Village is a hidden shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' which only offers limited brunch and requires reservations. Jialulan Coast in Taitung City was originally abandoned land, now transformed into a recreational area combining art and ecology, featuring multiple art installations, with one driftwood hut being especially popular. At night, Cheela Cabin Café's lights spill out through the plants, creating a mysterious, dreamy atmosphere. The beauty of these spots rivals the world of Miyazaki's Studio Ghibli animations.

levels.text: 1. 成功鎮：宜灣卡片教堂 介於海岸山脈與太平洋之間的台東，造就了許多不可思議的天然美景，在大自然相伴之下來首先抵達台東成功鎮。在小鎮北邊有個遺世獨立的「宜灣部落」，部落裡藏着一座超級逗趣的小教堂，名字就叫「卡片教堂」。卡片教堂本名叫宜灣長老教會，原本是樸素普通的木造屋，但因為老建築在1974年毀於颱風，之後在賴明德建築師的手下重建。走歐洲鄉村風的卡片教堂，從外牆到內部有着活潑圖騰與色彩點綴，就像復古聖誕卡片上印的Q版教堂，可愛到令人想撲上去，也吸引許多導演前來取景！ 2. 東河鎮：知路橋公車站 「希望時間暫停在這一刻，充滿魔法的地方。」在網路上有着如此評語的知路橋公車站，位在舊台11線的知路橋站旁，為台東擁有「最美的候車亭」之稱的公車站牌，是前往東河鄉買肉包時，必定要駐足的當地名景。 知路橋原本只是不起眼的公車招呼站，一支招牌用輪胎灌漿水泥插着而已，但在兩年多前由「無心巖」創辦人租下旁邊土地作為友善農作分享平台，才順便整理出供人免費使用的候車亭。利用天然石牆以及廢棄木料打造候車亭，背後倚着的駁坎小坵生長着巨大的老檜木，幾乎被自然包覆的場景，更顯出人類的渺小。 儘管無心巖已經退場，但留下空間遺跡仍舊迷人，吸引許多人遠道前來等公車，在霧色迷離的清晨與向晚時分，總是懷抱一絲希望，搞不好可以偶遇龍貓呢！ 3. 東河鎮：我在玩-玩冰箱 轉進阿美族傳統製陶聚落的隆昌部落，在這裡有間被網友譽為「全台最美路邊攤」的小店，用茅草屋頂、漂流木、熱帶植物構築的街角空間，不拘小節的自然風情，簡直「鬆」到不行！ 店名口語而隨性的「我在玩-玩冰箱」，是當地人才知的隱藏版早午餐店，同時也結合木工體驗以及在地小農產品，每日極限量供應的餐點，若沒有事先預約，根本沒機會吃到。我在玩-玩冰箱以「豐盛玩美」為概念，最令人驚豔的就是用天然木板集合擺盤料理的多人共享早午餐，那粗獷卻繽紛有如花藝創作的呈現手法，展現出台東海岸部落小農食材的多樣性，同時也呼應了追求天然原味的飲食概念，以及追求無拘無束的自由生活態度。 4. 台東市：加路蘭海岸 遺世獨立的加路蘭海岸，是距離台東市區不太遠，開車往北走僅需15分鐘左右，渡過卑南溪之後，就能抵達的靜好海岸。 加路蘭海岸位在小野柳風景區附近，這裡原本是廢棄土置場，為空軍建設志航基地機場所用，如今在東海岸國家風景區管理處的整頓下，結合藝術與生態工法打造為自然遊憩區。 沿着海岸散策，可見藝術家創作裝置，例如「類窗櫺」、「日昇之舞」、「風車組」、「哭泣的露珠」等，最深受吸引的，莫過於原住民藝術家伊祐‧噶照（Iyo Kacaw）用漂流木做出繭型小屋，這個取名叫「在海邊看書，好嗎? 」的小屋，與大海形呼應形成奇幻的風景，簡直就像小煤炭精靈的巢！ 5. 台東市：Cheela小屋咖啡館 夜裡，Cheela小屋點燃微渺燈火，光滲透過重重植物的包圍，像神秘的龍貓樹洞，指引着人們往深
levels.text_en: 1. Chenggong Town: Yiwan Card Church. Located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, Taitung is blessed with many incredible natural landscapes. We first arrive at Chenggong Town in Taitung. On the north side of the town lies the secluded 'Yiwan Tribal Village,' hiding within it a super charming little church called the 'Card Church.' Its formal name is the Yiwan Presbyterian Church. It was originally a plain, ordinary wooden building, but after the old structure was destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, it was rebuilt under architect Lai Mingde. With its European countryside style, the Card Church is decorated from its outer walls to its interior with lively patterns and colors, looking just like the cute, chibi-style church printed on a vintage Christmas card — so adorable that people want to run up and hug it! It has also attracted many film directors to shoot scenes there. 2. Donghe Town: Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop. Online, this bus stop has been described as 'a magical place where you wish time would stand still.' Located beside the old Zhilu Bridge Station on the former Provincial Highway 11, it is known as Taitung's 'most beautiful bus shelter' and is a must-stop local landmark on the way to buy meat buns in Donghe Township. Zhilu Bridge was originally just an unremarkable bus stop — a sign stuck into a tire filled with cement. But more than two years ago, the founder of 'Wuxin Yan' rented the adjacent land to create a friendly farming-sharing platform, and in the process tidied up the area into a free-to-use bus shelter. Built using natural stone walls and discarded wood, the shelter stands with its back against a small embankment where a giant old cypress tree grows — the scene almost entirely enveloped by nature, highlighting how small humans are by comparison. Although Wuxin Yan has since closed, the remaining space is still charming, drawing many people from afar to wait for the bus there. In the misty early mornings and evenings, people always hold a faint hope that they might just encounter Totoro! 3. Donghe Town: 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge.' Turning into Longchang Tribal Village, a traditional Amis pottery-making community, there is a small shop that netizens have called 'the most beautiful roadside stall in Taiwan.' Built with a thatched roof, driftwood, and tropical plants, this relaxed street-corner space has an unpretentious, natural charm that is utterly laid-back! With its casual, colloquial name 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' this is a hidden brunch spot known only to locals, also combining woodworking experiences with local small-farm produce. The extremely limited daily meals are impossible to get without a reservation. Built around the concept of 'abundant beauty,' the shop's most stunning offering is a shared brunch for multiple people, artfully arranged on natural wooden boards. This rough yet colorful presentation, like a floral art creation, showcases the diversity of ingredients from Taitung's coastal tribal small farms, while also reflecting a dining philosophy that pursues natural, original flavors and an unrestrained, free lifestyle. 4. Taitung City: Jialulan Coast. The secluded Jialulan Coast is not far from downtown Taitung — only about a 15-minute drive north, crossing the Beinan River, to reach this tranquil coastline. Jialulan Coast is located near the Xiaoyeliu Scenic Area. It was originally an abandoned soil dumping site used for the construction of the Air Force's Zhihang Base airport. Now, under the management of the East Coast National Scenic Area Administration, it has been transformed into a natural recreational area combining art and ecological engineering. Strolling along the coast, you can see artistic installations such as 'Quasi-Window Lattice,' 'Dance of the Rising Sun,' 'Windmill Set,' and 'Weeping Dewdrop.' The most captivating of all is the cocoon-shaped driftwood hut made by Indigenous artist Iyo Kacaw. Named 'Reading by the Sea, Shall We?', this hut echoes the ocean to form a fantastical scene, just like the nest of a little soot sprite! 5. Taitung City: Cheela Cabin Café. articles.title: 日本福井縣昨日暴雨　氣象部門一度發出最高級別大雨警報
articles.summary: 日本福井縣落好大雨，天氣部門發咗最高級大雨警報，叫幾十萬人要小心安全。

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日落好大雨，天氣部門一度發出最高級嘅大雨警報，叫福井市、大野市、同勝山市嘅四十萬人要小心安全。福井縣有地方冇咗，仲有車困喺水裡面。坂井市有個女人跌親受傷。
levels.text_en: It rained very heavily in Fukui Prefecture, Japan yesterday. The weather department at one point issued the highest-level heavy rain warning, telling the 400,000 people in Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City to be careful and stay safe. Some places in Fukui Prefecture had land collapse, and a car got stuck in water. In Sakai City, a woman fell and got hurt.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日落咗好大嘅雨，氣象部門一度向福井市、大野市、勝山市發出最高級別嘅大雨特別警報，叫呢三個市、總共四十萬居民要確保自己安全。福井縣至少發生咗四宗地質災害，有車輛被困喺水浸嘅道路上。喺坂井市，有一位女士喺水浸嘅路上跌倒受傷。數據話，勝山市、福井市同坂井市嘅二十四小時雨量都超過三百毫米，大野市嘅雨量亦超過二百五十毫米，係當地有記錄以嚟最高嘅，預計暴雨會持續到今日中午。
levels.text_en: Heavy rain fell in Fukui Prefecture, Japan yesterday. The meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City, telling the 400,000 residents of these three cities to ensure their safety. At least four geological disasters occurred in Fukui Prefecture, with vehicles trapped on flooded roads. In Sakai City, a woman fell and was injured on a flooded road. Data show that the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm, while Ono City's rainfall exceeded 250mm — the highest on record locally. The heavy rain is expected to continue until noon today.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日遭遇暴雨侵襲，當地氣象部門一度向福井市、大野市及勝山市發出最高級別嘅大雨特別警報，呼籲呢三個市合共四十萬名居民必須確保自身安全。福井縣境內至少發生四宗地質災害，其中有車輛被困於水浸道路上，情況相當危險。喺坂井市，一名女子喺水浸嘅道路上跌倒受傷，需要送院治理。根據數據顯示，勝山市、福井市同坂井市嘅二十四小時雨量均超過三百毫米，而大野市嘅雨量亦超過二百五十毫米，呢啲數字都係當地有記錄以嚟嘅最高紀錄。當局預計呢場暴雨最少會持續至今日中午，提醒居民仍要提高警覺，密切留意天氣變化。
levels.text_en: Fukui Prefecture in Japan was hit by heavy rain yesterday. The local meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City, calling on the 400,000 residents of these three cities to ensure their own safety. At least four geological disasters occurred within Fukui Prefecture, including vehicles trapped on flooded roads, a rather dangerous situation. In Sakai City, a woman fell on a flooded road and was injured, requiring hospital treatment. According to data, the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm, while Ono City's rainfall also exceeded 250mm — all the highest figures on local record. Authorities expect this heavy rain to continue at least until noon today, and remind residents to stay alert and closely monitor changes in the weather.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨天下暴雨，氣象部門一度對福井市、大野市和勝山市發出最高級別的大雨特別警報，提醒三市共四十萬居民注意安全。福井縣至少發生四起地質災害，有車輛被困在積水道路上。坂井市一名女子在積水路面跌倒受傷。數據顯示，勝山市、福井市和坂井市的二十四小時降雨量都超過三百毫米，大野市也超過二百五十毫米，均為當地歷史最高紀錄。預計暴雨將持續到今天中午。
levels.text_en: Fukui Prefecture in Japan had heavy rain yesterday. The meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City, reminding the 400,000 residents of the three cities to be safe. At least four geological disasters occurred in Fukui Prefecture, with vehicles trapped on flooded roads. A woman in Sakai City fell and was injured on a flooded road. Data show the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm, and Ono City also exceeded 250mm, both local historical records. The heavy rain is expected to continue until noon today.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日暴雨，氣象部門一度向縣內的福井市、大野市、勝山市，發出最高級別的大雨特別警報，呼籲這三個市、共40萬名居民，要確保自身安全。 福井縣發生最少4宗地質災害，有車輛被困在水浸的道路中。在坂井市，一名女子在水浸的道路上跌倒受傷。 數據顯示，勝山市、福井市和坂井市的24小時雨量均超過300毫米；大野市雨量亦超過250毫米，都是當地有記錄以來最高，預計當地暴雨最少持續至今天中午。
levels.text_en: Heavy rain hit Fukui Prefecture, Japan yesterday. The meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City within the prefecture, calling on the 400,000 residents of these three cities to ensure their own safety. Fukui Prefecture experienced at least 4 geological disasters, with vehicles trapped on flooded roads. In Sakai City, a woman fell and was injured on a flooded road. Data show that the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm; Ono City's rainfall also exceeded 250mm, both the highest on local record. The heavy rain in the area is expected to continue at least until noon today.

articles.summary_en: Heavy rain hit Fukui Prefecture in Japan, prompting weather authorities to issue the highest-level emergency rain warning for several cities; flooding caused hazards including a trapped vehicle and an injured woman.
